title: Infrastructure-layer deplatforming - app stores, registrars, hosting, CDN as the third chokepoint
source: Public record: AWS suspended Parler (Jan 2021); Apple + Google removed Parler from their app stores (Jan 2021); Cloudflare terminated Daily Stormer (Aug 2017), 8chan (Aug 2019), and Kiwi Farms (Sep 2022) - each time with public statements calling its own intervention a dangerous precedent (Matthew Prince blogs); Akamai/Fastly/CDN layer; domain registrars/registries (GoDaddy, Google Domains, Namecheap) and DNS as a further layer; Apple's ~30% cut + sole iOS app distribution as structural gatekeeping (cf Epic v. Apple). Overlay on the control-apparatus stack (Financial_Censorship + Online_Speech_Regulation + Digital_ID); structural edges only, no financial-core edges. HONESTY: the actions + dates = FACT; 'private anti-abuse / ToS / legal-compliance' vs 'infrastructure-level censorship with no due process' is CONTESTED - both framings presented, and Cloudflare's OWN stated reluctance is included as a fact that cuts against a simple-censorship read; the stack-convergence + competing-explanation points are labeled interpretation. No unified-cabal claim.

edges.notes: AWS suspended Parler's hosting (effective 10 Jan 2021) after the Jan 6 Capitol riot, taking the app offline for ~a month until it found new hosting. The clearest cloud-hosting deplatforming case: a single IaaS provider can remove a lawful (if noxious) service from the internet. AWS cited repeated ToS violations (violent content); critics called it infrastructure-level censorship without due process (fact of the suspension; framing contested).
Cloud hosting (AWS/Azure/GCP) is a chokepoint layer: a handful of IaaS providers host most of the web, so a hosting cutoff is near-total de-platforming (fact of concentration).

Apple is the SOLE distribution channel for iOS apps (no sideloading pre-DMA) and takes ~30% - it removed Parler (Jan 2021, restored Apr 2021 after moderation changes) and routinely gates apps. Structural gatekeeping power documented in Epic v. Apple; it is also where OS-level age/ID attestation now routes (fact of the chokepoint; moderation-vs-censorship framing contested).

Google Play removed Parler (Jan 2021) and others; Android allows sideloading, so Play is a softer gate than iOS - but with the 2026 Play 'Age Signals' + developer-verification moves it is tightening. The two mobile stores together are a duopoly gate on app distribution (fact; softer than iOS).
The Apple+Google app-store duopoly is the mobile-distribution chokepoint - removal from both effectively ends a consumer app (fact of the duopoly).

Cloudflare (CDN/DDoS protection) terminated Daily Stormer (Aug 2017), 8chan (Aug 2019), and Kiwi Farms (Sep 2022) - but EACH time CEO Matthew Prince published statements calling the intervention DANGEROUS and warning that an infrastructure provider policing content sets a bad precedent. That self-stated reluctance is a fact that cuts against a simple-censorship reading: the chokepoint is real AND its most-used operator says it should not be a speech arbiter (fact of both the terminations and the reluctance).

Akamai/Fastly and the CDN layer are peers in the same chokepoint class: DDoS protection + edge delivery are near-essential for a site at scale, so withdrawal can functionally silence a target (fact of the class).

Domain registrars/registries (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains) and DNS are a further layer: GoDaddy dropped Gab (2018) and AR15.com; registry/registrar seizures (ICE/NTIA-adjacent, court orders) can remove a name entirely. Losing the domain is losing the address (fact of the layer; case-by-case motive varies).

State speech law increasingly DEPUTIZES the infra layer: the EU DSA reaches hosting/intermediary services, the UK OSA reaches 'ancillary' services, and app-store age laws push duties onto Apple/Google. Law + infrastructure reinforce each other (interpretation, labeled; cf Online_Speech_Regulation).

COMPETING/PARALLEL FRAME: infrastructure (host/registrar/app-store/CDN), finance (card networks/processors), and law are THREE DISTINCT chokepoint layers on the same target - a site can be cut at the money, the content, or the pipe. Held as parallel mechanisms, not one cabal (interpretation, labeled; completes the money->law->infrastructure stack).

CONVERGENCE: app stores are becoming the age/ID-attestation layer (Apple Declared Age Range, Play Age Signals) - so the distribution chokepoint and the identity chokepoint merge at the OS/store (interpretation, labeled; cf the age-verification + Digital-ID threads).
